parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The channel ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters.

parameters.name: MaxIdleTime
parameters.description:
The idle timeout period. Unit: seconds. The value must be in the range of \[10, 86400].

> If you set this parameter, the task is automatically stopped when it has been idle for a period longer than MaxIdleTime. If you do not set this parameter, the task is stopped immediately after the channel is closed.

parameters.name: MixMode
parameters.description:
The stream mixing mode. Valid values:

- **0**: Single-stream ingest. The original single stream is ingested without stream mixing or transcoding. You do not need to configure stream mixing and transcoding parameters.

- **1** (default): Stream mixing and transcoding.

parameters.name: MultiStreamURL
parameters.description:
The parameters for ingesting to multiple URLs. You can specify multiple live ingest URLs.

> When you set the ingest URL for a task, you must configure either the StreamURL parameter or the MultiStreamURL parameter, but not both.

sub_parameters.name: IsAliCdn
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to ingest the stream to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

- false: Ingest to a non-Alibaba Cloud CDN.

- true: Ingest to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

> The default value is false.

sub_parameters.name: URL
sub_parameters.description: The live ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported. The maximum length is 2048 characters. For information about how to generate the URL, see [Ingest URLs and playback URLs](~~199339~~).

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region where the stream mixing service is located. Valid values:

- **CN-Shanghai<props="china">(default)</props>**: Shanghai.

- **AP-Singapore<props="intl">(default)</props>**: Singapore.

- **EMAA-Saudi**: Saudi Arabia.

parameters.name: SingleSubParams
parameters.description: The parameters for single-stream ingest. This parameter is required when MixMode is set to 0. Do not set this parameter for stream mixing and transcoding.

parameters.name: StreamURL
parameters.description:
The live ingest URL. Only the RTMP protocol is supported. Only one URL is supported. The maximum length is 2048 characters. For information about how to generate the URL, see [Ingest URLs and playback URLs](~~199339~~).

> - For domain names with hotlink protection enabled, the ingest URL must include an access token.

- Do not use the same StreamURL in different tasks at the same time.

- Do not use the same StreamURL within 10 seconds after a task stops.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The task ID. Only one ID is supported. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 55 characters. This ID is the unique identifier for the bypass ingest task.
If a task with the same ID still exists and has not been cleared when you start a new task, \`InvalidParam\` is returned.

parameters.name: TranscodeParams
parameters.description: The parameters for stream mixing and transcoding. This parameter is required when MixMode is set to 1. Do not set this parameter for single-stream ingest.
